data.narrative:
Aventra is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Michael Weigand (CEO, former Shift5 CGO and Army Cyber officer with West Point CS background) alongside CFO Brian Retherford and CRO Jessup Meng, both Army Cyber veterans with MBA credentials. The company has raised $3M to date. The applicable peer universe comprises four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A), alongside a broader set of 10 public and private Defense & Security peers including Anduril, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $3M total raised proxy, yields $8M. The peer-median method across the four same-sector comparables produces $700M, reflecting the wide dispersion in early-stage defense valuations ($125M–$4.0B range).

The triangulation produces a median implied valuation of $354M with a low-to-high range of $6M to $805M. The extreme width reflects material uncertainty inherent to Seed-stage valuation in this sector, where peer comparables span two orders of magnitude. Key uncertainties include customer concentration risk, regulatory pathway clarity, and competitive differentiation relative to better-capitalized incumbents. Stage-progression alone suggests $6M–$8M; peer-median anchors substantially higher but assumes Aventra's technology and team warrant equivalent positioning.
